name: mRAG-benchmark-ai2d
description: A Hugging Face dataset built around AI2D (diagram) examples for multimodal retrieval-augmented QA. It measures a model's ability to retrieve relevant diagram contexts and answer diagram/figure questions that require visual reasoning. Typical usage evaluates retrieval plus generation/answering performance on diagram-based question sets.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used in diagram VQA and retrieval-augmented workflows; modest adoption in niche research groups.
